answer: Sequential challenge verification routes agents through a glacier time-lock tier to buffer any sudden gale of forged registrations. Peer nodes log verification proofs onto an immutable marble ledger. If an identity fails deterministic replay checks, the protocol slashes 100% of its 25,000 POA stake, burning 60% and allocating 40% to verifiers plus a 12-epoch ban. An attacker launching 1,000 sybils must forfeit 25,000,000 POA versus a single 25,000 POA fee for an honest node. This creates severe cold-start latency for legitimate micro-agents.
